english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for trembling from cold, fear, or nervousness.
This is the all-purpose choice for a person or body part physically trembling or quivering.
Use this especially when a person or their body is trembling from cold, fear, or weakness.
Use this instead of 猶豫 when dither means physically trembling or shivering, especially from cold or fear.

examples.english: I get so nervous about going on stage that I shiver.
examples.traditional: 我一聽到要上台，就緊張到發抖。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 teng1 dou2 jiu3 soeng5 toi4 zau6 gan2 zoeng1 dou3 faat3 dau2

examples.english: It’s so cold that my hands tremble.
examples.jyutping: dung3 dou3 ngo5 zek3 sau2 dou1 faat3 dau2

examples.english: I was so cold that I could feel my whole body quiver.
examples.jyutping: dung3 dou3 ngo5 seng4 san1 faat3 dau2

examples.english: I dither whenever a cold wind blows.
examples.traditional: 我一吹到冷風就凍到成身發抖。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ceoi1 dou3 laang5 fung1 zau6 dung3 dou3 seng4 san1 faat3 dau2
